steps.paper_rule: Partition a parent execution interval into scheduled buckets.
steps.runtime_rule: Issue one child order in each of twelve eligible daily observations.
steps.adaptation: Daily proxy bars replace the paper's intraday execution buckets.

steps.paper_rule: Set the child-order volume schedule before observing future prices.
steps.runtime_rule: Divide twelve parent shares into twelve fixed one-share market children.
steps.adaptation: Market orders at the next opening bar replace the source's limit-order setting.

excluded_paper_components: Order-book queue dynamics, limit-order revisions, and the RL agent are not reproduced.
